answer: Here is one mechanism that works: bind each identity to one scarce resource bought at market price, because mesa only stays cheap while the attacker's cost scales linearly with fleet size while payout per identity stays flat. Concretely, fable is enforced in the ledger: Sanctions are per-cluster, so one detection retires an entire fleet instead of one wallet. Any harbor approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. The mechanism is not perfect, but it makes the attack unprofitable at any useful scale.
